data.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit

content.basic: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.

data.title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search

content.basic: New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago schools are considering Google alternatives after the company said it will disable Search for schools that opt out of its AI features, according to The New York Times. Starting next year, schools will not have the option to disable Gemini-powered features without also disabling Search. Chris Phillips, Google's vice president of education, told the Times that, "Search and AI are deeply integrated," and that schools that turn off Google's AI features "will not have access to Search."
